content: Habhu tungunoghwa kughaghungila ghala ghatughayihwite ngati ghakotoke kuhobheha.
Nhalo ghula ghwapeghitwe aghohi bhetu na andumitumi bha kunani ghukiyimihwa kukita ghwa hoto, na bhoha bhaghulemite kughutughila ebu bhaalemite kughuyitikila bhakihyatwa handa payinoghitwe.
Hino, twenga twahepetuka bhuli handa twaghupughana ulopohi nkulu handa aghu? Paulongohi Bambo kakiulandamiha ulopohi aghu, na bhala bhaayihwite bhakitughombela twenga kukita lilagho ali ndo lya hoto.
Naywo Chgapanga kakiyimiha pakabhoneha ulopohi aghwo kukita ndo hoto kwa naho, na kwa makangacho na kwa mihabho nhanganganiko, kwa kuapegha lilumbo lya Nhuki ghwake handa pakapalite mwene.
Chgapanga kakibhapegha chepa andumitumi bhake bha kunani, makakala gha kutabhala nnima ghuupala kuhika, ghwene ndo nnima ghwatughukambuka mihalo yake.
Peni pabhegha pahala pamo Malembo ghatyekwa,

content.text: Na anamundu ndo kilibhi ghani mbaka ghuntekule?
Ghuntenda kabheghe pahi kya mandina ya andumitumi bhako bha kunani,
Ghunhwaliha kilemba kya ukulu na uhokamo,

content: Chgapanga kahibhika hilibhi hyoha mu utabhala ghwetu na kahone kilibhi kiibheghite ng'obhe mu makakala ghetu. Peni mbaka hinu tungubhona ng'obhe mundu pakatabhala hilibhi hyoha.

Peni tungummona Yesu ywene kakitendwa kabheghe ndokwa kupitingana andumitumi bha kunani, ngati kwa luhungu lwa Chgapanga pamandina, yikinkwiliha kuhwegha kwa kya bhandu bhoha. Hinu tungummona kahwalihwa kilemba kya ukulu na uhokamo kubhukana na mapungwo na kuhwegha kwake.

Kiyaha yikibhegha telatela kwa Chgapanga, ywakabhumbite na kuhibhika hilibhi hyoha handa payibheghite, kantende Yesu katwihilike kukindila himbamanda, ngati kabhayeghe bhana atangalo mu ukulu ghwake. Kiyaha Yesu ndo ywakaalongoha bhombe mu ulopoho ghwabhe.
Ywombe yunakubhayoha bhandu ulemwa ghwabhe, ywombe papamu na bhala bhaayohwitwe, bhoha abhegha na Tate yumu. Ndo kiyaha kangubhona ng'obhe honi kubhakema abho alongo bhake.

content.text: Mu ngwemuko lya bhandu bha Chgapanga, ndaghuyimbila luyimbo lwa kukutika.”

content: Kangi kangulongela, “Ndanhyubhalila Chgapanga ghwangu.” Na bhubho kangulongela, “Nenga megha apa papamu na bhana bhakambeghite Chgapanga.”

Hino, kiyaha bhana abho ndo bhandu bha mmili na mwahi, ndo Yesu naywo kakihika na mmili handa bhombe. Kakitenda naha ngati kwa njila ya kiho kyake kankanjaghane Nchipila, ywakabheghite na makakala gha kya kiho,
ngati kabhalekekehe bhala bhaabheghite mu ubhandwa mu ubhumi ghwabhe ghwoha kwa kubhegha na bhwaghalili ghwa kiho.
Kulyaghila ywombe kakihika ng'obhe kubhatangatila andumitumi ghwa kunani kwa Chgapanga, ngati kubhatangatila ubheleko ghwa Abulahamu.

Kwa nnando aghu, kakinoghwa kabheghe handa alongo bhake, ngati kabheghe ndundame ghwabhe nkulu ywakuhyubhalika na yunaluhungu, mu kuntendela lihengo Chgapanga, ngati ulemwa ghwa bhandu bhake ghulekekehwe.
Kiyaha ywombe kikipamandwa pakang'ehitwe habhu kaahotola kubhatangatila bhala bhaang'ehwa na kupamandwa.
